terms.label: Amategeko
terms.title: Amabwiriza n’amategeko y’imikoreshereze
terms.summary: Amabwiriza shingiro yo gukoresha Kungahara neza, mu mutekano kandi ufite inshingano.

acceptance.title: Kwemera aya mabwiriza
acceptance.body: Gufungura konti cyangwa gukoresha Kungahara bivuze ko wemeye aya mabwiriza. Niba ukoresha Kungahara mu izina ry’ubucuruzi, wemeza ko ufite ububasha bwo kuyemera mu izina ryabwo.

service.title: Gukoresha Kungahara
service.body1: Kungahara itanga ibikoresho byo gucunga amakuru y’ubucuruzi nk’ububiko, ibyagurishijwe, imari, imyenda n’inyandiko. Ugomba kuyikoresha gusa mu bikorwa by’ubucuruzi byemewe n’amategeko.
service.body2: Ntugomba gukoresha nabi urubuga, kubangamira imikorere yarwo, kugerageza kurwinjiramo utabyemerewe cyangwa kurukoresha mu guhonyora uburenganzira bw’undi muntu.

accounts.title: Konti n’umutekano
accounts.body1: Tanga amakuru y’ukuri igihe wiyandikisha kandi uyavugurure. Ni wowe ushinzwe ibikorwa bikorerwa kuri konti yawe no kurinda ijambo ry’ibanga n’uburyo ukoresha winjira.
accounts.body2: Tumenyeshe vuba niba ukeka ko hari uwinjiye muri konti yawe atabyemerewe.

businessData.title: Amakuru y’ubucuruzi bwawe
businessData.body1: Amakuru n’inyandiko ushyira muri Kungahara bikomeza kuba ibyawe. Utwemerera kubitunganya gusa kugira ngo dukoreshe, turinde, tubungabunge kandi tunoze serivisi.
businessData.body2: Ni wowe ugomba kwemeza ko ufite uburenganzira bwo kohereza no gukoresha amakuru abitswe aho ukorera.

availability.title: Kuboneka kwa serivisi
availability.body: Dukora kugira ngo Kungahara ikomeze gukora neza, ariko ishobora rimwe na rimwe guhagarara kubera kuyitunganya, umutekano cyangwa impamvu tudashobora kugenzura. Ibiyigize bishobora kuvugururwa uko porogaramu itera imbere.

decisions.title: Ibyemezo by’ubucuruzi
decisions.body: Kungahara itunganya amakuru utanga, ariko si ubujyanama mu ibaruramari, imisoro, amategeko cyangwa imari. Genza neza imibare y’ingenzi kandi ugishe inama inzobere ibifitiye ubumenyi mbere yo gufata ibyemezo bikomeye.

suspension.title: Guhagarika cyangwa gufunga konti
suspension.body: Dushobora kugabanya cyangwa guhagarika uburenganzira bwo gukoresha urubuga igihe konti yishe aya mabwiriza bikomeye, ibangamiye serivisi cyangwa abandi bakoresha, cyangwa amategeko abidusabye. Ushobora guhagarika gukoresha Kungahara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose no gusaba ko konti yawe isibwa mu igenamiterere.

changes.title: Impinduka kuri aya mabwiriza
changes.body: Dushobora kuvugurura aya mabwiriza uko Kungahara itera imbere. Niba impinduka igira ingaruka zikomeye ku burenganzira cyangwa inshingano zawe, tuzakumenyesha mbere y’uko itangira gukurikizwa. Gukomeza gukoresha serivisi nyuma y’itariki yatangiriyeho bivuze ko wemeye amabwiriza avuguruye.

privacy.label: Ibanga
privacy.title: Politiki y’ibanga
privacy.summary: Ibisobanuro byoroshye by’amakuru Kungahara ikusanya n’uko amakuru yawe acungwa.

information.title: Amakuru dukusanya
information.body1: Dukusanya amakuru ya konti nk’amazina yawe, aderesi ya e-mail, izina ry’ubucuruzi, ifoto y’umwirondoro n’amakuru akoreshwa mu kwinjira. Dutunganya kandi amakuru y’ububiko, ibyagurishijwe, imari, imyenda n’inyandiko uhitamo gushyira aho ukorera.
information.body2: Amakuru y’ibanze ya tekiniki ashobora gukoreshwa kugira ngo serivisi ikomeze kuba mu mutekano kandi ikore neza.

use.title: Uko dukoresha amakuru
use.body: Dukoresha amakuru mu gufungura no kugenzura konti, gutanga ibikoresho byo gukoreramo, kohereza amatangazo wasabye, gusubiza ubutumwa bw’ubufasha, kurinda serivisi, gukemura ibibazo no kunoza Kungahara.

authentication.title: Kwinjira n’amagambo y’ibanga
authentication.body1: Amagambo y’ibanga abikwa ahinduwe mu buryo burinzwe aho kubikwa uko yanditswe. Ijambo ry’ibanga ryemeza rikoreshwa gusa kureba ko amagambo ahura kandi ntirigera ribikwa.
authentication.body2: Nuhitamo kwinjira ukoresheje Google cyangwa Microsoft, uwo mutanga serivisi azaduha amakuru y’ibanze akuranga umaze kubyemera. Ntitubona ijambo ry’ibanga ukoresha kuri uwo mutanga serivisi.

sharing.title: Igihe amakuru asangizwa abandi
sharing.body1: Kungahara ntigurisha amakuru yawe bwite. Amakuru ashobora gusangizwa abatanga ibikorwa remezo na serivisi gusa igihe bikenewe mu kwakira urubuga, kohereza e-mail, kugenzura abinjira, kubika dosiye no kohereza amatangazo kuri mudasobwa.
sharing.body2: Dushobora kandi gutanga amakuru igihe amategeko abidusabye cyangwa igihe bikenewe mu kurinda abakoresha, serivisi cyangwa abaturage.

retention.title: Kubika amakuru n’igihe amara
retention.body: Tubika amakuru igihe konti yawe igikora n’igihe gikenewe mu gukoresha serivisi, kubahiriza amategeko, gukemura impaka no kubungabunga umutekano. Igihe amakuru abikwa gishobora gutandukana bitewe n’ubwoko bwayo n’impamvu abitswe.

choices.title: Amahitamo yawe
choices.body: Ushobora guhindura umwirondoro n’amakuru y’ubucuruzi, kugenzura uko wakira amatangazo, kubika inyandiko z’ubucuruzi zemewe no gusaba ko konti isibwa mu igenamiterere rya Kungahara. Ushobora no kutwandikira ufite ikibazo cy’ibanga cyangwa ushaka gukosora amakuru.

security.title: Uko turinda amakuru
security.body: Dukoresha uburyo bwo kugenzura abinjira, kwinjira mu mutekano, ibimenyetso bimara igihe gito n’ubundi buryo bwa tekiniki bugenewe kurinda amakuru yawe. Nta sisitemu yo kuri interineti ishobora gutanga umutekano wuzuye, bityo nawe ugomba kurinda amakuru ya konti yawe.

changes.title: Ivugururwa rya politiki
changes.body: Dushobora kuvugurura iyi politiki uko Kungahara n’uburyo bwo kurinda ibanga bitera imbere. Impinduka zikomeye zizamenyeshwa mbere y’uko zitangira gukurikizwa kandi itariki iri hejuru izavugururwa.
